description: Canonical decision table for session-start reconciliation (D-25). On resuming a gated A2+ objective, the ledger is read and observed state re-derived mechanically BEFORE any new gate cycle; a MISMATCH blocks planning until the ledger is corrected (CORRECT_FIRST), a claimed-verified task with absent acceptance evidence is itself a MISMATCH and reverts to unverified, and corrections never spend down cycles or layer2_passes (the ratchet - reconciliation is not a budget refund). check-reconcile-invariants.py enforces this table; policy/recovery.md section 8 is its prose.
